title: Mudcovered Letter (hunter)
wikitext:
The '''Mudcovered Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Horde|1|Mudcovered Letter (quest)|Mudcovered Letter|race=Goblin|class=rogue}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
<name>, I heard the beautiful BOOMS coming down from the coalpits. Figured it must be you, the others had pitiful booms, quite boring, too.

Interested in learning how to make even bigger booms with different kinds of tricks and shots? I can teach you a few things to help you against the wildlife around here, and who knows, maybe you'll have your own pet one day! Just holler at me and I'll cover everything you need.

Mayten Boomrifle, Hunter Trainer.
}}

==Patch changes==
* {{Patch|1.17.1|note=Added, replaces [[Leather-Covered Letter]].}}
